Extra Gooey Cinnamon Rolls (Bakery-Style & No-Knead) Dough * 1 tsp yeast * 2 tbsp sugar * 343 g milk (about 1½ cups) * 480 g flour (about 4 cups + 2 tbsp) * 1 tsp salt * 60 g softened butter (about 4 tbsp) Filling * 140 g softened butter (10 tbsp) * 140 g brown sugar (about ⅔ cup) * 3½ tbsp ground cinnamon Butter Vanilla Frosting * 85 g softened butter (6 tbsp) * 180 g powdered sugar (about 1½ cups) * 1 tbsp vanilla extract Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the yeast, sugar, and milk. Add the flour and mix until combined. Add the salt and softened butter, then stretch and fold (or coil fold) until the butter is fully incorporated. 2. Cover and let the dough rise for about 2 hours, or until doubled in size. 3. Roll the dough into a large rectangle. Spread the softened butter evenly over the dough, then sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon. 4. Cut the dough into 6 long strips, then roll each strip into a cinnamon roll. 5. Sprinkle a little of the cinnamon sugar mixture into the bottom of the pan, then place the rolls on top. 6. Cover and let them rest for 15 minutes. 7. Mix a little milk with 1 tbsp melted butter, then spoon about 2 tbsp of the mixture over each cinnamon roll. 8. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 25–30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. As soon as they come out of the oven, cover them with a clean kitchen towel until warm. Then spread the frosting on top. That’s the key to extra-soft cinnamon rolls. #cinnamonrolls #cinnamonroll #baking #bread #breadtok

In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

videos.caption: Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

HEALTHIER banana bread choco chip cookies 🍌🍪 1/2 cup salted butter 1/3 cup maple syrup 1 medium ripe banana, mashed well 1 large egg  1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1 3/4 cups almond flour 1 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp salt 2/3 cup of chocolate chips Sea salt to top Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir continuously until its bubbling and browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and let cool for 20 minutes. Add the cooled browned butter, maple syrup and banana to a large bowl and whisk until smooth. Whisk in the egg and vanilla until combined. Fold in the almond flour, baking soda and salt until fully combined. The dough should be wet almost like a banana bread batter. Transfer to the fridge to firm up for 15 minutes while the oven preheats.  Preheat oven to 375F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Fold in the chocolate chips until just combined. Scoop 12 cookies onto the baking sheet. Bake for 8-11 minutes until outsides are golden and center is still soft. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

Recipe Name Strawberry Cheesecake Crumble Bars Ingredients 1. 2 cups graham cracker crumbs 2. 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted 3. 1/4 cup granulated sugar 4. 16 oz (450 g) cream cheese, softened 5. 3/4 cup granulated sugar 6. 2 large eggs 7. 1 tsp vanilla extract 8. 1/2 cup sour cream 9. 3 cups fresh strawberries, chopped 10. 1/3 cup granulated sugar 11. 2 tbsp cornstarch 12. 1 tbsp lemon juice 13. 1 tsp vanilla extract 14. 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour 15. 1/2 cup old-fashioned oats 16. 1/2 cup brown sugar 17. 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted 18. 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon 19. 1/4 tsp salt 20. 1/2 cup crushed graham crackers, for topping Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a 9×13-inch baking dish with parchment paper. 2. Combine the graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and 1/4 cup sugar until the mixture resembles wet sand. 3. Press the crumb mixture firmly into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. 4. Bake the crust for 8–10 minutes, then remove and let it cool slightly. 5. Beat the softened cream cheese and 3/4 cup sugar until smooth and creamy. 6. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. 7. Mix in the vanilla extract and sour cream until the cheesecake filling is completely smooth. 8. Spread the cheesecake mixture evenly over the cooled crust. 9. Combine the chopped strawberries, 1/3 cup sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, and vanilla in a bowl. 10. Let the strawberry mixture stand for about 5 minutes so the berries release some of their juices. 11. Spoon the strawberry mixture evenly over the cheesecake layer. 12. In another bowl, combine the flour, oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt. 13. Pour in the melted butter and mix until coarse, crumbly pieces form. 14. Sprinkle the crumble mixture generously over the strawberry layer. 15. Scatter the crushed graham crackers evenly across the top. 16. Bake for 40–50 minutes, until the edges are set and the center has only a slight jiggle. 17. Allow the dessert to cool completely at room temperature. 18. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight, to fully set the cheesecake layer. 19. Lift the chilled dessert from the pan, cut into squares, and serve cold or slightly softened. Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe
